summary.text: Clark Boyd is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 46, where he has served since January 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Boyd is on the ballot with Dominic Howard.

paragraphs.text: Clark Boyd is the owner of an insurance agency in Lebanon, Tennessee.
He took office representing District 46 on January 11, 2018.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Commerce, Finance, Ways, and Means, and Health committees.
Boyd's 2014 campaign website, as quoted by Ballotpedia, described him as a veteran of the Army National Guard and U.S. Army Reserve and stated his opposition to a state income tax.
